- [ ] Does the PR have proper description or ticket reference added?
- [ ] Are you clear with all the requirements of this story? (not clear? connect with dev and clear the doubts before starting review.)
- [ ] Are all variables and functions used somewhere? Do the variables and functions have properly cased, and meaningful names?
- [ ] No unnecessarily duplicated logic
- [ ] Code intent is clear upon initial reading. Any code that isn't clear, but is needed, has an effective comment.
- [ ] The functions can appropriately handle unexpected inputs.
- [ ] Commented code has been removed (comments themselves are fine).
- [ ] Can a better solution be found in terms of maintainability, readability, performance, or security?
- [ ] Does similar functionality already exist in the codebase? If yes, why isn’t it reused?
- [ ] Can you think of any use case in which the code does not behave as intended? any inputs or external events that could break the code?
- [ ] Is error handling done the correct way?
- [ ] Are error messages user-friendly?
- [ ] Are there any potential impacts on other parts of the system or backward compatibility?
- [ ] Does the code introduce any security vulnerabilities?
- [ ] Code does not contains html generated by concatenating user input?
- [ ] Code does not have dom interaction using jquery or other native apis?
- [ ] Safehtml pipe being used instead of trusthtml?
- [ ] Do you see any potential to improve the performance of the code significantly?
- [ ] if we are fetching the data on page load and saving in store, are we clearing it while switching the firm to avoid showing wrong firm's data?
- [ ] Have verified the changes in the platform and works fine?
- [ ] Are the changes WCAG compliant?
